description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Reace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Pia Nalaar triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
